from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """A provided paper: its title and which other provided papers it references."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="This paper's title")
    references_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of OTHER provided papers (from the document summaries) that appear in this paper's reference list")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
